paragraphs: CLC 160 engines with the M271 supercharged 1.8-litre petrol four-cylinder commonly show timing chain stretch and balance shaft issues over time, a pattern well-documented across Mercedes specialist circles. We replace the timing chain, timing gears and gaskets as standard on every M271 rebuild.
